Game Overview

In Save Baby Capybaras - Pull Pin, the core idea is straightforward: navigate through adorable puzzles, strategically pulling pins to reunite baby capybaras with their dad. Carefully decide as some decisions could backfire! Earn rubies to unlock charming character skins and climb the global leaderboard. With 100 levels and delightful challenges, it's a heartwarming adventure!
